prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted functional hints (photo quality, path helper, account security), select clean layouts (card carousel, single-click identity), key desktop flows (summon, visibility/control), and specific hotkey copy.
Harmful changes: Major structural overhauls (docking setup flow, split personality redesign), spotlight and split view layouts, interactive practice flows, and certain copy changes.
No effect seen: Wait time, progress, and status indicators, background notifications, desktop prep or tutorial screens, and incentive badges consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: High predictions (+8.0% or above) consistently overestimated actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or negative drops.
Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially desktop visibility/control flows, shortcut hotkey copy, summon flows, security hints, and story reordering—far exceeded low or negative predictions.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Hotkey Control Cheat Sheet Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding wrap-up screen showcasing key desktop hotkeys and visual shortcuts for controlling, hiding, and interacting with the desktop companion. (why: Support received multiple complaints about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.)
1: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Sign-In Session Persistence Verification Flow: Introduces an explicit account session verification indicator during sign-in to guarantee companion data persistence across app restarts. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Identity Notice Hint: Displays an inline security reassurance hint on the sign-in screen confirming that signing in protects existing pet data from being lost. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after re-authenticating.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Generation Interactivity Status: Shows dynamic background generation status and estimated completion time on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting screen in home step has high mean duration (2336s) causing user uncertainty during pet creation.)
4: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Finalize Action Copy: Updates adoption certificate button and headline copy to emphasize immediate desktop availability upon completion. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate at 64.2%.)
5: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Compact Grid Selection Layout: Switches pick_friend selection layout to list mode with quick-view preview badges for faster adoption choice. (why: Adoption conversion drops significantly (64.2%), requiring a clearer presentation of pet choices.)
6: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Quick Desktop Test Launch Callout: Adds a prominent welcome badge and action prompt to test pet desktop interactions immediately upon entering home intro. (why: Support emails noted confusion on how to interact or talk to pets once onboarding finishes.)
7: [home, notification] Background Generation Notification Toggle: Enables desktop ready notification option on the waiting screen so users know when their pet is loaded without staring at the window. (why: Mean time in home waiting screen is 2336s, leading users to leave the app window while generation completes.)
